## Objective
- Build a complete, playable “HCR2 Unlimited everything” game in the repository.

- Don’t ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks (viewport at most 1280px wide) and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Built a standalone browser game inspired by Hill Climb Racing 2, with endless terrain, unlimited coins, maxed upgrades, selectable vehicles, and keyboard/touch controls.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added the game page, responsive styling, canvas gameplay, vehicle selection, HUD, menus, fuel and collectibles.
- `node --check game.js` passed.
- Browser opened at `http://localhost:3002`; page title is `Hill Climb Unlimited`.

- Verify browser console error, take and inspect a screenshot, and test gameplay interactions.

### Blocked
- Browser reported `Console: 1 errors, 0 warnings`; the error has not yet been inspected.

## Next Move
1. Inspect the console error with `playwright-cli console`.
2. Take a small JPEG screenshot and inspect the latest one.
3. Test starting a run, movement, pause/restart, and garage vehicle selection; fix any issues.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game UI and overlays.
- `style.css`: Responsive visual design and touch controls.
- `game.js`: Canvas renderer, physics, input, menus, and game state.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- A local server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- Playwright Chromium was installed after the initial missing-browser error.
